ai_review.summary: Decent audience‑sourced recording that captures a solid show highlighted by Black Peter and the slower “Aiko” performance.
ai_review.review: The single review praises the band’s playing, especially Bob’s vocal ad‑libs and a strong rendition of Black Peter, while noting the longer, slower Aiko as a standout. The recording contains noticeable crowd noise early on but is described as "not bad sound at all," suggesting an audience or matrix source with acceptable clarity.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed 4‑star review highlights good musical performance and acceptable recording quality; limited data keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crowd noise is prominent in the first set, less so later; overall sound described as "not bad" with no major issues reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set has noticeable crowd presence; second set settles down and maintains momentum.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bob was in good form with scats and ad‑libs on this summer tour.
